property.name: storageAccountName
property.description-key: Azure Storage Account Name (e.g., mystorageaccount)

property.name: containerName
property.description-key: Azure Blob Container Name

property.name: uploadAuthMode
property.description-key: How to authenticate with Azure Blob Storage or OneLake

property.name: sasRequestUrl
property.description-key: Server endpoint to request SAS tokens (for SASFromServer mode). Example: https://api.example.com/generate-sas

property.name: sasToken
property.description-key: Direct SAS Token for Azure Storage (for DirectSASToken mode). WARNING: Use short-lived tokens only

property.name: uploadEndpoint
property.description-key: Server endpoint for proxy uploads (for ServerProxyUpload mode)

property.name: oneLakeWorkspaceId
property.description-key: Microsoft Fabric Workspace ID (GUID)

property.name: oneLakeLakehouseId
property.description-key: Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse ID (GUID)

property.name: oneLakeBasePath
property.description-key: Base path inside the Lakehouse (e.g., Files)

property.name: oneLakeUserSubPath
property.description-key: Optional user-specific sub-path (can be bound). Leave blank to derive from current user.

property.name: aadTokenRequestUrl
property.description-key: Server endpoint to obtain a short-lived AAD access token for scope https://storage.azure.com/.default

property.name: oneLakeChunkSizeMB
property.description-key: Chunk size for OneLake DFS append operations

property.name: oneLakeFolderUrl
property.description-key: (OneLakeDirectToken only) DFS folder URL, e.g. https://onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/{workspaceId}/{lakehouseId}/Files/test_powerapps

property.name: aadAccessToken
property.description-key: (OneLakeDirectToken only) Bearer token for scope https://storage.azure.com/.default (DEV ONLY)

property.name: acceptedFileTypes
property.description-key: Select the file types that can be uploaded

property.name: maxFileSizeMB
property.description-key: Maximum file size allowed for upload in megabytes

property.name: enableMultiple
property.description-key: Allow uploading multiple files at once

property.name: maxFileCount
property.description-key: Maximum number of files allowed when multiple upload is enabled

property.name: enableChunkedUpload
property.description-key: Enable chunked upload for large files (>50MB)

property.name: chunkSizeMB
property.description-key: Size of each chunk for chunked uploads

property.name: enableMetadata
property.description-key: Enable metadata collection for uploaded files

property.name: userNameProperty
property.description-key: Metadata property name for user information

property.name: timestampProperty
property.description-key: Metadata property name for upload timestamp

property.name: userEmailProperty
property.description-key: Metadata property name for user email
